stem.text: ‘If an object is in equilibrium, the sum of the clockwise moments about a point X is equal to the sum of the anticlockwise moments about a point Y.’
Which condition would make the student’s statement correct?

A.text: Either X or Y is the centre of gravity of the object.

B.text: Either X or Y is the pivot of the object.

C.text: X and Y are at opposite ends of the object.

D.text: X and Y are the same point on the object.
